_about: Every outside company whose servers a visitor's browser reaches from this site: the template's own code (when: always, scroll, consent) and the platform's standard pastes in Studio, which load with the page once pasted (when: paste). The firm's privacy policy is drafted from this list (monorepo BI/rules/legal-pages.md, the LEGAL family). The scrub guard (scripts/check-template-is-blank.mjs) fails the build on any real host the template names that its PLATFORM_HOSTS does not allow, and lib/__tests__/outsideVendors.test.ts fails when an allowed host is neither a vendor here nor in linkOnly with a reason: so a new outside script cannot merge without its vendor. A host is a hostname or *.suffix. Adding a vendor adds a company to every firm's privacy policy: say so in the pull request.

vendors.name: Sanity
vendors.purpose: stores the website's content and delivers its images
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details, with each image request

vendors.name: YouTube (Google)
vendors.purpose: plays videos, in its privacy-enhanced mode
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; a video's preview image loads before play, and the player may set or read cookies

vendors.name: Vimeo
vendors.purpose: plays videos, with its do-not-track setting
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; essential player cookies

vendors.name: Google Analytics
vendors.purpose: measures how visitors use the website, only after a visitor accepts
vendors.receives: pages visited, time on them, referrer, device and browser, approximate location from the IP address; sets cookies

vendors.name: Fillout
vendors.purpose: provides the contact form; form messages are stored for the firm in Zite
vendors.receives: what the visitor types into the form, IP address and browser details

vendors.name: Google Maps
vendors.purpose: shows an office's location on a map
vendors.receives: IP address and browser details; may set or read cookies

vendors.name: Elfsight
vendors.purpose: shows the firm's Google reviews in a widget

linkOnly.sanity.studio: hosted Studio addresses for the firm's editors; never loaded by a visitor
linkOnly.api.sanity.io: the content API, called by the server at build and render; never by a visitor's browser
linkOnly.schema.org: a structured data namespace, never fetched
linkOnly.youtu.be: short video links the site reads to find a video's id
linkOnly.fonts.google.com: font license attribution; fonts are served by the site itself
linkOnly.vercel.sh: a configuration schema address, never served
linkOnly.jsdelivr.net: a configuration schema address, never served
linkOnly.nextjs.org: a documentation link in generated code
linkOnly.facebook.com: a link to the firm's profile; nothing loads from it
linkOnly.instagram.com: a link to the firm's profile; nothing loads from it
